description.value: The Skript Kitchen is Vancouver's premier certified gluten-free commissary kitchen, housed in a new building in the Olympic Village neighbourhood, offering shared kitchen memberships to culinary entrepreneurs and food-manufacturing businesses. A front Sunroom hosts Bakery by Jany, where gluten-free baked goods are available for walk-in purchase, and the space regularly runs public cooking classes and community food events. The facility was founded by Renée Chan, a Registered Dietitian and Chef, with a mission to support food-business scale-up in a professionally managed, allergen-safe environment.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands at 42m; stands (2 spaces) at 91m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Skript Kitchen is a gluten-free commissary kitchen and event space in Olympic Village, not a traditional public cafe — though Bakery by Jany operates from the front Sunroom selling baked goods to the public, and cooking classes/events are open to registration. The contact page corroborates the OSM address (250 W. 3rd Ave) and supplies a phone number absent from OSM. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site; Wi-Fi is confirmed for space users and GF status is explicitly confirmed.
concerns: OSM amenity tag is 'cafe' but the business is a commissary kitchen; public access is largely limited to the front Sunroom bakery and ticketed cooking classes/events — a passing cyclist may find limited drop-in service.
Phone number (604) 347-5587 is absent from OSM but confirmed on the website contact page; added from website source.
Full postal code (V5Y 1G1) is absent from OSM but confirmed on the website contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating business at the stated address in Olympic Village with public-facing retail (bakery) and ticketed events accessible to any visitor, including touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Bakery by Jany is a sub-tenant operating from the Sunroom — if it ever gets its own OSM node, that record may duplicate the retail food offering at this address.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags this as amenity=cafe, but the business is primarily a shared commissary kitchen with membership access; public-facing retail is limited to an in-house bakery (Bakery by Jany) and ticketed events. Category Food & Drink is broadly acceptable but the cafe sub-tag is inaccurate.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated certified gluten-free facility; FAQ confirms 'Yes, we are a dedicated gluten-free kitchen.'

Wi-Fi.detail: Website states 'Use our dependable Wi-Fi and essential amenities to connect, collaborate, and grow your culinary business' — available to users of the space; not confirmed as freely available to walk-in bakery customers

wow_evidence: Vancouver's premier certified gluten-free commissary kitchen
